---
title: "Whole-machine utilization"
engine: knitr
---

CPU percentages and RAM bytes are separate units, not interchangeable resource
percentages. `CPU-RAM.rds` is a replacement generator's selected-campaign
summary, not the historical Windows intermediate. Partial coverage is excluded
from aggregates and retained in the attempt ledger. RAM figures use GiB.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
source("R/reporting.R")
benchmark_report_page("utilization")
```
